name: Tri
description: The spitter, drawn alone at eight heads in the same leather and wool as Dot. Tri let the hive's work be done on it so it could throw acid, and the body is the price: a belly swollen into a sac the size of the chest, the wool tunic stretched over it with a stitched seam running down the front where it was opened and closed, a leather band buckled round it and two straps over the shoulders holding it up, and a glass flask of bile on the hip for what it cannot hold. The head is `ss.lib.tri-head` composed at a fifth of its size — a leather cap with goggles pushed up on it, a leather muzzle with a brass spout at the front stained where the acid comes out, a throat swollen into a gland under the jaw — and the dead organ hangs on a cord above the belly as a pendant. A short open leather jacket, a bracer and gloves; thin legs in wrapped gaiters and ankle boots, which is what carries all that at speed. Two dead feelers, shorter than Dot's, lie back over the cap and hang behind the shoulders. It stands back on its heels with the belly forward, and it waddles. No skin anywhere but the face and the throat. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: standing back on the heels with the belly forward: the sac breathes — a slow swell and settle bigger than any chest could make — and the band round it rides the swell; the flask on the hip sways, the feelers laid back over the cap twitch, and the head lifts a hair on the in-breath

walk.description: a waddle: short quick steps on thin legs under the weight, the belly bouncing a beat behind the hips and swelling on each drop, the flask swinging, the arms held a little out for balance, the feelers bobbing
